name: Rubik's Tetris 3x3 Cube
description: Two legendary puzzles collide in the Rubik’s Tetris 3x3 Cube — a clever twist on the classic Rubik’s Cube that challenges you to think in shapes, not colors. Instead of solving solid-colored sides, your goal is to restore all six iconic Tetris Tetriminos to their original forms.
features: Rubik’s × Tetris Crossover: Combines two of the most iconic puzzle games ever created
Shape-Based Solving: Focus on rebuilding Tetriminos instead of matching colors
Advanced Challenge: Level 4 difficulty for seasoned solvers and brain-teaser fans
STEM-Friendly Fun: Encourages spatial reasoning, problem-solving, and strategic thinking
Display-Ready: Includes an I-Tetrimino stand for showcasing your solved cube
Official Rubik’s 3x3 format with Tetris-inspired design
